'''Paul McPherson Corulag Operatives''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Paul McPherson]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/bb7.htm Corulag Operatives], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031210170125/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/bb7.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul McPherson]]

* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
